title: Workiva-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) \- Senior position**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced professional with strong focus on Enterprise Performance management (EPM) areas to join EY FAAS team. The ideal candidate will bring subject matter expertise in FP\&A and/or Consolidation \& Reporting processes to enhance our FAAS services.
   

  

 Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise \-
+ Working with clients to understand business challenges and identify solution to drive desired outcomes
+ Performing current state assessment of client accounting, reporting, and reconciliation
+ Developing system requirements, designing, user acceptance test stories, training, defining support procedure and implementing with specific focus on Workiva Wdesk, Wdata and integration with data source system/s
+ Mapping data flow and to identify optimal design and governance option as well as potential risk
+ Using Wdata \& Wdesk to create templates, connections, data flows, integrations, etc
+ Focus accounting and finance domain area of reporting and data management including financial, management regulatory reporting, internal controls, global statutory reporting
+ Redesign processes to eliminate inefficiencies and incorporate best practices
+ Stay updated with the latest industry trends, regulations, and advancements in reporting optimization process, sharing knowledge and insights with the team
+ Support project management activities, including project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring project progress
+ Proficient in developing KPIs, performance value driver analysis, and implementing Driver based planning models
+ Develop detailed documentation and deliver training programs and workshops to enhance end user understanding and proficiency in Reporting solution during the handover


* Business Development \& Solution Development \-
+ Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements \& formulate that in solutions
+ Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
+ Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
+ Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
+ Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
+ Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
+ Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Business Skills and Knowledge –
+ Strong business development skills
+ Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
+ Strong solution/product build skills
+ Strong project management skills


* Human Skills –
+ Excellent written \& oral communication \& articulation
+ Flexible work attitude
+ Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
+ Strong collaboration skills
+ Ability to comprehend complexity quickly \& apply solutions
+ Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
+ Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem \& solutions
+ Strong problem solving skills
+ Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
+ Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or MBA with 2\-6 years of relevant experience
* Experience in end\-to\-end implementation of Workiva solution in Financial Reporting, ESG and GRC space.
* Experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, process documentation, data integration, and data analytics
* Strong communication, team building, teaming and presentation experience
* Experience in SQL and system integration
* Experience with ETL tools (Power BI, Alteryx)
* Experience in leading and developing team
* Demonstrated problem solving and critical thinking skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments/responsibilities
* Experience and certified with Workiva solution.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-DR-ITCA-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting –** 
 Manager, IT Controls Advisory
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in shape to your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As a TR\-ITC manager, you’ll contribute technically to Risk Assurance client engagements and internal projects. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with stakeholders as required.
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer(client/onshore). As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Participate in IT Risk and Assurance engagements.
* Proficiency in using audit software tools, data analytics techniques, and IT auditing techniques. Strong analytical skills are necessary for interpreting technical data, identifying patterns, anomalies, and areas of concern.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to IT governance, data protection, privacy, and cybersecurity. This includes regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and industry frameworks like COBIT and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles, structures, and processes to ensure that IT activities align with business objectives, comply with regulations, and mitigate risks appropriately.
* Proficiency in identifying, assessing, and managing IT\-related risks to ensure that adequate controls are in place to mitigate potential threats to the organization's information assets, systems, and operations.
* Familiarity with IT auditing principles, techniques, and tools to assess the effectiveness of IT controls, identify control deficiencies, and recommend remediation actions.
* Proficiency in understanding IT systems, networks, applications, and infrastructure to design and implement controls effectively. This includes knowledge of common technology platforms, such as operating systems, databases, cloud services, and cybersecurity tools.
* Strong project management skills are necessary for planning, coordinating, and executing internal control initiatives effectively. This includes managing resources, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure that control objectives are achieved in a timely and efficient manner.
* The ability to lead and mentor a team of IT control professionals, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities. Strong leadership qualities include decision\-making, delegation, conflict resolution, and fostering a collaborative work environment.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, IT leadership, internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities. This involves understanding stakeholder expectations, managing communications, and addressing concerns in a collaborative and constructive manner.
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in application controls and Information security experience.
* Ability to build relationships with key stakeholders across different levels of seniority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* Preferably Bachelor’s degree in (Finance/Accounting, Electronics, Electronics \& Telecommunications, Comp. Science)/MBA/M.Sc./CA
* Minimum of 7\-8 years of experience in internal controls and Internal Audit
* Enterprise risk services with specific focus on IT and related industry standards
* IT Risk Assurance framework
* Control frameworks such as COSO, internal control principles and related regulations including SOX and J\-SOX
* Preferred security skills related to a broad range of operating systems, databases or security tools, e.g., UNIX, Linux, Windows 2000 and NT, firewalls and IDS systems
* Familiarity with IT analysis, delivery and operations methods, including ITGC, ITAC,SDLC, PAM and CM
* Familiarity with security and risk standards such as ISO 27001\-2, PCI DSS, NIST, ITIL, COBIT
* Experience of security testing methods and techniques including network, operating and application system configuration review
* Application controls and security experience:
+ sensitive access and SOD testing
+ controls testing
+ Knowledge of data analysis tools like MS Excel, MS Access, MS SQL Server, ACL, Monarch, etc.

* Preferred Certifications: CISA


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-infrastructure and Cloud Security- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high\-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise \& cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero\-trust and micro\-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns \& develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity \& Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well\-versed in encrypting all end\-to\-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per\-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go\-to\-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity\-based micro\-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero\-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience across Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800\-207, NIST 800\-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose** 
 : To lead the Project Controls team and manage all project planning, scheduling and cost management activities to ensure that projects are completed on time, on budget and required project services are delivered to Worley, and its client’s requirements.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead the team, manage employee development and support career progression for the function.
* Ensure the services the team deliver meet project requirements to specified quality, on time and are within budget.
* Drive a culture of accountability within the group and enforce necessary measures when performance is inadequate.
* Drive a culture of ‘doing it right first time’ and delivering high quality deliverables that are part of fit for purpose solutions.
* Drive adoption of GID’s new way of operating.
* Build capability in the function to match capability needs identified by Works Management.
* Support implementation of a high performance delivery and unified GID organisational culture which spans across geographic locations and cultures.
* When necessary, perform project controls services.
* Ensure Continuous Improvement through the implementation of an Annual Improvement Plan and addressing lessons learnt.
* Develop, implement, improve and maintain Worley project controls systems, processes, practices and procedures.
* Review proposals for suitability of project scope, cost and scheduling requirements and coordinates development of all data in support of negotiations in line with Worley guidelines.
* Review Control budgets prepared for the projects and monitor deviation of the project cost with respect to the budgets prepared.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Interface with Project Management and Finance and Governance to prepare monthly internal reports, project control statements and MPRD reports.
* Partner with Workforce Planning to forecast personnel needs for projects.
* Liaise with other departments at meetings relative to project operations, to ensure that information affecting the project plan is continually updated.
* Proactively resolve any discrepancies between Worley and client’s requirements.
* Keep up to date with developments and innovations in the function.
* Demonstrate commitment to Zero Harm through regular actions and courageously speak up if work is being performed unsafely.
* Take accountability for own development and support the learning of others in areas of own experience by providing support to them as they are learning.
* Take initiative to get things done and do things before being asked by others.
* Apply standard procedures and processes to consistently deliver individual and team goals.
* Actively demonstrate WorleyParsons values and beliefs.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested from time to time by the leadership team.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* 15\+ years of technical, practical and leadership experience in Project Controls in the same or similar industry, managing and leading large multi\-disciplinary projects and teams including 10\+ years of experience as project controls engineer / project planning engineer in engineering delivery organisation.
* Recognised degree in the relevant area or equivalent qualification/experience.
* Commercial experience, including contracts and procurement.
* Competent in the use of Primavera software package, Microsoft Excel, Access and other project controls specific software like PRA, Fuse etc.
* Able to make difficult decisions and lead others in changing business conditions.
* Can manage and resolve conflict between individuals and/or groups.
* Strong in negotiation of successful outcomes that achieve the required objectives and have the support and acceptance of all parties.


**Generic Competencies**
* Able to influence others, think ‘on your feet’ and have ability to work as part of a high performing team.
* Able to work effectively in small multi\-disciplinary teams, and share and transfer knowledge within teams.
* Able to share information to diverse audiences.
* Can listen and ask questions to ensure understanding.
* Able to use effective cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Able to develop and propose new approaches, methods, or technologies in response to changing business conditions.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: License Owner & Operator, Kolkata
description:
**Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
   

  

 Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Kolkata.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community\-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
 Visit
 **www.strangersoccer.com** 
 and explore the
 **"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"**

 Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.

 Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10\+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
   

  

**Ready to be part of the journey?**
 We'd love to hear from you.

title: Foundry Production Manager
description:
We're starting a new manufacturing plant in Kolkata. Using the lost\-wax/investment casting process, this venture will create multiple B2B and B2C brands, acting as a hub for metal/alloy casting from East India. We have already tested the market by outsourcing to third\-party vendors (Jaipur, Moradabad, Rajkot), even created one of the intended brands with a solid customer base. Now, we're about to in\-house the entire production within greater Kolkata area, from start to finish.
 



  





 For running this plant, we need a professional with several years of foundry experience.
 



  




* Experience with non\-ferrous alloys like Zamak and brass.
* Preferred to have experience with lost\-wax or investment casting process, but similar processes like die\-casting or sand casting can be considered as well.
* Ideally, you should have some idea about the entire production process from molds, wax patterns, and ceramic slurry mixtures to casting and finishing/polishing.
* We're open to having you join us as a partner or on a profit\-sharing basis, instead of a salary.



  





 Further, we'd prefer it if you have one or more of the following qualities:
 



  




* Fixing production issues and finding smart solutions for casting\-related defects
* Contacts/leads of workers and artisans we can approach to work under me
* Supervising a plant during the day and ensuring quality production
* Experience in export\-quality production where items were sold out of India
* Specialization in smaller parts and decorative items
* Technical background to adjust issues with sprues/gates and material composition
* Mechanical background to fix issues with casting\-related machinery
* Good grasp on the post\-production process (finishing, filing, polishing, buffing, etc.)

 Project Planning \& Scheduling

* Assist in budget planning and project forecasting activities.



 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  




* Maintain project planning documentation, schedules, and progress records.
* Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards and procedures.
* Support contract management by providing schedule\-related inputs for claims and extensions of time (EOT).

* Experience managing planning functions for large and complex projects.

* Expert knowledge of
 **Primavera P6** 
 , MS Project, and project scheduling techniques.
* Strong understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) and project control methodologies.
* Proficiency in project reporting, forecasting, and schedule analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Design Studio is a collaborative practice of designers, architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to creating thoughtful, functional living spaces. The studio focuses on vernacular contemporary design, blending local character with modern comfort and usability. Projects emphasize purity in design, natural materials, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. Team members work closely together to deliver spaces that feel cozy, livable, and intentionally crafted. The culture supports creativity, technical excellence, and a commitment to sustainable, people\-centered design.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day activities at project sites. This position coordinates with designers, architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring site progress, managing manpower and resources, maintaining quality control, and documenting work through reports, photographs, and checklists. The Site Supervisor also handles basic issue resolution on site, escalates technical concerns to the design and engineering teams, and supports adherence to timelines and budgets. The role involves regular site inspections, communication with clients or client representatives, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to supervise construction sites, including monitoring daily activities, coordinating trades, and ensuring adherence to design and technical specifications.
* Strong skills in site planning and organization, including scheduling, resource allocation, and basic project coordination with internal teams and external vendors.
* Working knowledge of construction methods, materials, and finishes relevant to residential and vernacular contemporary designs, with attention to quality and safety.
* Competence in documenting site work through reports, measurements, photographs, and checklists, and maintaining accurate records for project tracking.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients, and for resolving routine on\-site issues.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and translate plans into clear instructions for site teams.
* Understanding of basic health, safety, and environmental standards applicable to construction sites in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
* Relevant experience as a Site Supervisor or similar role in architecture, interior design, or construction projects; residential or small\-scale projects experience is advantageous.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience may be considered.
* Willingness to work primarily on site, travel between project locations within the metropolitan area, and adapt to changing project demands.
